param: C Constant recruitment in susceptible population per year
h Proportion of men in the population
c Proportion of heterosexual men among all men
Λh Recruitment rate of susceptible homosexual men
Λw Recruitment rate of susceptible women
Λm Recruitment rate of susceptible heterosexual men
μ Natural mortality rate (l in paper)
δ AIDS development rate in treated individuals (ART resistance/failure)
α Departure rate from infected compartments to treated (a in paper)
βh Transmission rate between homosexual men (product of contact rate ch and probability bh)
βs Transmission rate between heterosexual men and women (product of contact rate cs and probability bs)
βhw Transmission rate from homosexual men to women (product of chw and bhw)
βhm Transmission rate from homosexual men to heterosexual men (product of chm and bhm)
